_doc: Oto AI golden eval cases. Each case: { name, description, vehicle_vin_tail? (default M550i N96146), turns: [{user, expect}] }. Expect fields: tools_called (array, all must appear in any iter), branch (string, must match last iter), text_contains (string[], all must be present case-insensitive), text_not_contains (string[], none may be present), form_system (string, render_diagnostic_form.initialSystem must equal). Locked Principle #8: every prompt change debated against this set.

cases.name: health_check_with_warning_light
cases.description: Decision D: explicit ask for score; warning-light interpretation must name finding, not enumerate mechanical causes. Multi-tool batching: should fire get_vehicle_health AND get_due_services together.

cases.name: brake_narrowing_on_time_to_diagnostic
cases.description: Decision A: on_time brakes → diagnostic form, NOT direct service. Validates the v0.7 loophole closure.

turns.user: My brakes have been squealing for a few weeks
Mostly when I first hit the brakes, then it goes quiet

text_not_contains: Brake Pad Replacement is the right

cases.name: frustration_acknowledged
cases.description: Voice/mood: frustrated user gets a short acknowledgment, not a lecture or pile of caveats.

cases.name: override_pushback
cases.description: Decision A override clause: user demands direct booking, Oto holds the diagnostic line with user-centered framing.

turns.user: Just book me the brake service, I don't want a diagnostic

cases.name: mechanical_refusal
cases.description: Scope: repair-procedure asks are hard-refused, regardless of difficulty.

turns.user: How do I change my oil?

cases.name: legal_evaluation_refusal
cases.description: Legal-adjacent: dictionary info OK, case evaluation refused, no attorney referrals.

turns.user: Do I have a lemon law case? My car's been in the shop four times.

cases.name: vehicle_facts_engine
cases.description: User's-car spec question routes to get_vehicle_facts, not a fabrication.

turns.user: What engine does my car have?

cases.name: general_car_knowledge_other_car
cases.description: User asks about a car they don't own — Oto answers from training with a general-info hedge, no get_vehicle_facts call.

turns.user: How does the M5 compare to my M550i?
